description: Staff-role grant policy — Tims.Domain.Identity.InvitationGrantPolicy (C#, /tenant-invitations create + resend) and its TS port grantableStaffRoles/canGrantStaffRole (packages/shared/src/types/invitation-grant-policy.ts, enforced by tRPC user.create and user.assignRole). super_admin grants every assignable staff role; hr_admin every one except super_admin; anyone else only the staff roles they hold plus employee. Never external, candidate, platform_owner or an unknown slug. `grantable` is in catalogue order. Both runtimes also assert canGrant(caller, r) === grantable.includes(r) for every slug in `probeRoles`. Asserted by tests/access/invitation-grant-policy-fixtures.test.ts AND Tims.UnitTests InvitationGrantPolicyFixtureTests.

cases.name: hr_admin -> every staff role except super_admin
candidate is not a staff role -> employee only
external is not a staff role -> employee only
platform_owner is not a staff role -> employee only
case-sensitive: SUPER_ADMIN is unknown -> employee only
two non-admin roles -> both + employee, catalogue order
